items.title: Coverings become surjections after sheafification

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that the map from the coproduct of the representable presheaves of the members of a covering to the representable presheaf of the target becomes surjective after sheafification (statement lines 2627-2639). The proof is a short complete argument: surjectivity is replaced by the epimorphism property (proof lines 2642-2643); morphisms from the representable sheaf are identified with sections of an arbitrary sheaf (proof lines 2644-2646); and the required injectivity of the induced map on morphism sets is precisely the sheaf property for the covering (proof lines 2647-2649). The non-formal content is the identification of morphisms with sections. The claim is H1: a two-step argument with each input named.
